appraisal_events.evidence: elle et Mme de Villeparisis tombèrent un matin l'une sur l'autre dans une porte et furent obligées de s'aborder... la marquise prit l'habitude de venir tous les jours... s'asseoir un moment près de nous dans la salle à manger... nous attardions-nous souvent à causer avec elle.
appraisal_events.explanation: After the earlier mutual avoidance, chance forces grandmother and Mme de Villeparisis into an unavoidable greeting that blossoms into genuine daily intimacy, reversing the earlier exclusion and admitting the family into the marquise's orbit at the hotel.

appraisal_events.evidence: ayant constaté, sans erreur possible, les mille prévenances dont nous entourait et dont l'entourait elle-même Mme de Villeparisis, Françoise l'excusa d'être marquise... elle la préféra à toutes les personnes que nous connaissions.
appraisal_events.explanation: Françoise's initial suspicion of the marquise's title gives way to genuine admiration once she witnesses Mme de Villeparisis's constant kindnesses toward the family, coming to prefer her above everyone else they know.

appraisal_events.evidence: Sa calèche s'était arrêtée devant l'hôtel, un valet de pied était venu parler au directeur... avait rapporté des fruits merveilleux... avec une carte : « La princesse de Luxembourg »... le lendemain soir Mme de Villeparisis nous envoya la grappe de raisins... et des prunes et des poires.
appraisal_events.explanation: The reigning princesse de Luxembourg's visibly staged gift, delivered through the hotel director and staff, publicly confirms Mme de Villeparisis's standing in the highest society, and she extends that largesse to grandmother and the narrator by passing the fruit along.

status_effects.explanation: She moves from deliberate mutual avoidance to a warmly maintained daily acquaintance with Mme de Villeparisis, crossing into her circle at the hotel.
As part of the household, he shares in grandmother's newly opened connection with the marquise, included in her company and attentions at meals.
She wins over even the proud, nobility-suspicious Françoise through sustained personal kindness, becoming Françoise's favorite among the family's acquaintances.
The princess's public, elaborately staged gift, witnessed by the hotel's director and staff, visibly confirms her standing among the highest society.
